recurrence_reference.interpretation: Repeated surface form is the trunk; entity/reference continuity is a proposed related offshoot.

local_composition_a.interpretation: Immediate-left-token composition: word pieces, hyphenation, fractions, and short grammatical relations.

local_composition_b.interpretation: A second weight-distinct immediate-left-token composition motif.

boundary_multiscale.interpretation: Document, line, and sentence boundary transport as related segmentation scales.

hypotheses.S1_semantic_routes_enrich: Every family has median semantic-edge energy enrichment at least 2 over edge prevalence on held-out rows.
hypotheses.S2_frozen_heads_beat_layer_controls: Every family median enrichment exceeds the median of all native heads in the same layers.
hypotheses.S3_semantic_edges_are_causal: Every family has positive median downstream KL and absolute next-token log-probability change after semantic-edge removal.
hypotheses.S4_semantic_edges_beat_matched_controls: At least two families have median semantic-edge KL at least 1.5 times their same-destination magnitude-matched nonsemantic controls.
